title: 1930s homesteader accounts of cattle mutilation on the property

tellings.quote: Our investigation has unearthed the fact that there are accounts that go back to the 1930s with the early homesteaders of bizarre cattle mutilation and other strange activity on this property.

plain: Strange cattle mutilations and other odd happenings were reported on Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah, as far back as the 1930s, by the first families who settled there. Brandon Fugal, the ranch's owner, says his team's research turned up these old accounts, though he does not name the sources. He tells it to show that the strange activity on the ranch goes back long before anyone famous was looking at it.
